t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ndisanizya, Guku Mulungu wane ati wambumba kigele nkumanye na kukwisenga B'eb'e. Ndizumilizya, henaha ku vugayiwa nguzu kwane na kuvusondo wako, kubapina wane na kuvusavi wako. Kuduhu Mulungu ungi sumbwa B'eb'e wakisa mumaluduko na wa kuhola kuhanya.
